shortDescription: Amazon Echo Spot (newest model), Great for nightstands, offices and kitchens, Smart alarm clock, Designed for Alexa+, Black
fullDescription: Amazon Echo Spot (newest model), Great for nightstands, offices and kitchens, Smart alarm clock, Designed for Alexa+, Black

reviews.author: Valerie Higuera
reviews.comment: I absolutely love this Echo Dot! One of my favorite features is that you can customize the color of the clock display, which makes it easy to match my space. I chose the black version because it fits perfectly with my black, white, and beige office aesthetic.The sound quality is great for its size, and the volume gets surprisingly loud. I also really like being able to see the time and when music is playing on the display—it’s a small feature, but I find it very useful throughout the day.Setup was incredibly easy. Connecting it to the Alexa app only took a few minutes, and everything worked right away.The only feature I wish it had is the ability to display photos, but I understand that’s not what this model is designed for. Even without that, it’s an excellent smart speaker, and I’m very happy with my purchase. I would definitely recommend it!

reviews.author: Tia Rae
reviews.comment: The Amazon Echo Spot is a fantastic addition to my home! I love how compact and stylish it is while still having so many useful features. The sound quality is surprisingly good for its size, and the display makes it easy to see the time, weather, notifications, and other information at a glance.Setting it up was quick and easy, and Alexa responds clearly and accurately. I especially enjoy using it to play music, set alarms and timers, check the weather, and control my smart-home devices. It’s convenient to have everything right at my fingertips without taking up much space.Overall, the Echo Spot is a great little smart device that looks good, works well, and makes everyday tasks more convenient. I definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a compact smart speaker with a helpful display!

reviews.author: Jovhany Bros
reviews.comment: The new Amazon Echo Spot is a great addition to my home. Its compact design fits perfectly on a nightstand, desk, or kitchen counter without taking up much space, and the Ocean Blue color looks modern and stylish. The display is bright and easy to read, making it perfect as a smart alarm clock, while Alexa makes it simple to set reminders, check the weather, control smart home devices, play music, and answer questions with just my voice. The speaker sounds surprisingly good for its size, and the setup was quick and hassle-free. It’s a versatile smart device that blends convenience with a sleek design, and I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: BriGuy
reviews.comment: Imagine waking up, looking at your clock to see if it's a good time to get out of bed, and instead of the time you see a video ad... and that's why the Echo Show 5 is, at least now, a poor choice for a bedside alarm clock. So, enter the Spot, thanks to a low upgrade price. First impressions are good - has everything I want and need from the device - clock, weather, alarm, ability to play music and news - and none of what I don't - NO ADS! (At least not yet, hopefully never.) All I had to do to get it set up was plug it in - everything was done automatically. It's a good size, and the clock looks good with some options and is easily readable from across the room. The sound is OK and if I want more I have it paired via bluetooth with a stereo system, just like my Show 5 was. The screen is actually a small square - it's not the entire upper half of the device as it may appear - might be nice if it was but for the lower upgrade price it's fine, with good color, quality and animations. I was so frustrated with my Show 5 displaying ads and yelling at it to "SHOW THE CLOCK" only for it to quickly go back to an ad that I had started unplugging it. So while the Spot may be seen as a "downgrade," for me it's actually an upgrade.

reviews.author: noszero
reviews.comment: Best Echo by far and on sale it's a steal! I got mine and IMMEDIATELY ordered a second one.Having the clock moved my echo front and center and eliminated my ancient alarm clock. You can adjust the brightness and clock face/colors on the spot. I am old and even I can see it and READ IT with no glasses. Win.It has a night mode that you set the times for, dims the screen so you can sleep. I like that.Played some music on it, wow. Way good sound for a tiny device.There is a dock available with USB ports also ( don't need it so no review) if you have a speaker or device you needs power it's covered with the dock. A well thought out device. I liked the Pop because you can see the blue notification light when it comes on. Right on the front where it should be. This is the same. The other echo ball things suck, you can't see when it lights up good enough. Buy this one. A clock that the time is always right on, weather icons, custom clock face. Yeah this is the only echo I am using now. It's that good and I have 6 echos. Had them the first year they were released to replace my Google nest mini device that would not work.I have an echo show, does blink camera live video. That's the only thing the spot can't do. But the spot has the clock up and you can read it, all the time. Spot wins. Best Echo, no question. A+ Amazon. Btw Amazon the blink app sucks, errors so much. There now you believe me since it's not all Amazon fluff and praise. This device is awesome.

name: Wall Charger, Surge Protector, QINLIANF 5 Outlet Extender with 4 USB Ports
shortDescription: Wall Charger, Surge Protector, QINLIANF 5 Outlet Extender with 4 USB Ports
fullDescription: Wall Charger, Surge Protector, QINLIANF 5 Outlet Extender with 4 USB Ports

reviews.author: maria de guzman
reviews.comment: I purchased the QINLIANF 5 Outlet Extender with 4 USB Charging Ports and surge protection for use at home, and it has been very convenient and useful.The design is compact yet highly functional, with 5 AC outlets and multiple USB ports that allow me to charge several devices at once. The 3-sided layout is especially helpful because it prevents plugs from blocking each other, even when using larger adapters.The built-in surge protection (1680J) provides peace of mind for protecting my electronics from power spikes. I also like that it plugs directly into the wall, which helps reduce cable clutter and keeps my setup organized.The USB ports are convenient for charging phones, tablets, and other small devices without needing extra adapters. Charging speed is decent for everyday use, and it’s very practical for bedside or office setups.Overall, this is a reliable and space-saving power strip that works well for home, travel, or office use. I would definitely recommend it for anyone looking to expand their charging options in a neat and efficient way.

reviews.author: Mariecal
reviews.comment: I absolutely love these outlet extenders! Having only two outlets in one spot is never enough anymore, especially with how many devices we use and charge every day. I actually have one of these in almost every outlet that we regularly use around the house.The five outlets give me so much more room to plug everything in, and having four USB ports built in is incredibly convenient for charging phones and other devices without needing additional charging blocks. I also like the three sided design because it gives larger plugs more space and keeps everything from feeling crowded.I use these every single day and honestly do not know how I managed without them before. They are practical, convenient, and make such a difference in keeping all of our devices powered. Definitely one of those household items I would buy again!

reviews.author: Scott Ames
reviews.comment: Honestly, this little outlet extender has been an absolute lifesaver for our home. Between charging iPads, phones, and plugging in a couple of lamps, our kitchen counter was always an absolute mess of power bricks and tangled cords—especially on Sunday mornings when everyone was trying to plug their devices in before church. I grabbed this hoping to clean up the chaos, and it exceeded my expectations. The three-sided design is super clever because you can actually fit those bulky, awkward power adapters on the sides without blocking the front outlets, and having the four USB ports built right into the front means we don't even need those extra charging blocks taking up space anymore.What really sold me, though, is how sturdy the thing is. Most wall splitters feel cheap and end up pulling right out of the drywall when you try to unplug a tight cord, but the center mounting screw locks it right into our standard wall socket so it doesn't budge at all. It handles everything from my husband's power tools out in the garage setup to our kids' nightstand gadgets without flickering or overheating, and the built-in surge protection gives me total peace of mind during those crazy summer thunderstorms that roll over the mountains. It completely solved our outlet shortage overnight, and I'm already planning to order a couple more for our home office and the basement!

reviews.author: Trish Anne
reviews.comment: I bought the 3U1C because it also has the C port not just the USB port. I love how I can keep the plate in the wall, plug it in and screw it to the base to ensure it’s not going to fall out all while keeping no gaps.The plugs fit nicely. The ports show 3.4 charging combined but the unit really does have a nice charge to it with the right cables. I like the white over tan and grey. Makes turning a two plug outlet into a 5 plug plus with a quick 40 install. No noise. Very sturdy once you add the extra long screw that it came with. And the price is great!! Very well done!

reviews.author: BlankFrank
reviews.comment: With two adults and two teenagers in the house, charging time can get a bit congested and with only two normal outlets, getting plugged in can be a challenge. Enter the Wall Charger and Surge Protector. With 5 electrical outlets, there's plenty of room for USB chords and their charging blocks, and you have 3 more USB-A and a single USB-C outlets that you can plug directly into. It certainly adds to the convenience of getting a good charge on my phone and also my tablet.The fit and feel of this Wall Charger and Surge Protector indicates that this device is designed to last. Nothing cheap or poor quality of materials to complain about.Of note: With one device plugged in, this charges relatively quickly. When you add a second, it slows down a bit and with everyone all plugged in at the same time, it can take a while, but if you're charging overnight or during dinner (no devices at the dinner table) r during a movie, you're probably good.

name: Sony WH-CH520 Wireless On-Ear Bluetooth Headphones with Microphone, Black
shortDescription: Sony WH-CH520 Wireless On-Ear Bluetooth Headphones with Microphone, Black
fullDescription: Sony WH-CH520 Wireless On-Ear Bluetooth Headphones with Microphone, Black

reviews.author: Dale Ross
reviews.comment: If you spend a lot of time on virtual meetings or listening to long audio formats, the Sony WH-CH520 headphones are a fantastic, budget-friendly choice.I use these primarily for Microsoft Teams meetings and listening to podcasts, and they perform beautifully. The built-in microphone captures crisp, clear vocals without picking up a ton of distracting background noise, which is exactly what you want for work calls. Audio playback is sharp and balanced, making spoken-word audio very easy to focus on.A few standout features:Insane Battery Life: They offer up to 50 hours of battery life on a single charge. You can literally go a couple of weeks of heavy daily use without ever plugging them in.Multipoint Connection: You can pair them to two Bluetooth devices simultaneously. I have them connected to both my laptop and phone, and they seamlessly switch over when a call comes in.Lightweight Comfort: The on-ear design is lightweight and well-padded, so they don't give you that heavy, clamped feeling during long marathon meetings.If you need a reliable workhorse headset for daily productivity, calls, and audio tracking, you really can't beat these for the price. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: jimbo
reviews.comment: I've been using these every single day for the past four months, and I honestly can't believe how good they are for the price!! The battery life is absolutely INSANE. One full charge lasts me almost an entire month, even with daily use. I keep expecting the battery to die, and it just...doesn't!?!The noise cancellation isn't 100%, but I'd say it's around 70%, which is more than enough for me. It does a great job cutting out background noise so I can focus, and the sound quality is fantastic for $30 price range. Comfortable fit, I use for music, podcasts, and movies which all sound clear and balanced. Easy connectivity too with bluetooth on my TV and Apple products.If you're looking for an affordable headset with that classic over-ear look, amazing battery life, and really solid sound quality, I can't recommend these enough. I'm genuinely blown away by how well they've held up!

reviews.author: Kevin Miles
reviews.comment: I bought these because I needed something that would allow me to enjoy music, pod casts and many other videos without being tied to my desk computer or iPhone. One main reason is I needed something that sounded good but nothing overly priced like my AirPods Pro that only get about 2 hours of listening. These are rated for up to 50 hours. And the best part was the fact they were inexpensive connect to more than one bluetooth device (my M4 Mac mini and my iPhone 14) in addition I needed something to be able to have a conversation if my phone rings while I am on my Mac. and these have worked so far flawlessly.Set up was a bit more then I expected I figured connect via bluetooth and off I would go but no, I did have to download the app to fine-tune the Headphones which wasn't a big deal. While they are not of the highest quality they are perfect for me and my listening needs.Incoming calls were a breeze and everyone I spoke to so far while wearing them had no issues hearing me. Now, I am a bit amphrehensive about the battery life because at the whole day yesterday of wearing them the battery monitor on my Mac claim the headphones were still 100%. and if that is true then they are even better than I was expecting battery wise. I did recharge them over night because I wasn't sure if the Mac was telling me the truth.The voice interaction with my phone calls were very clear and I have no complaints.The fit is really nice if you ask me and they are very light weight, after wearing them almost all day I would forget they were on and have to take em off.They are very comfortable to wear and I noticed just how light they were when I pulled them off and carried them over to where I plugged them in to re-charge.Of course it's only been a couple of days so, if I can edit this review at a later time I will do so, if there is a need to. I mean after only a few days these are brand new so I do need to give them more time. Surprisingly, my ears have not began to sweat with them being on all day, although. I do have issues with my ears being itchy from time to time but that's not because of the headset. That's just my ears.For the price the quality for me is really good.I may listen to a song or two but, I mainly wanted something to last longer than 2 hours if I watch YouTube or other streaming videos on my computer or iPhone. As well, they release my nice wired set that I used, I got tired of tripping over the wire and my office chair rolling over the cord and getting tangled up. Plus the added convenience of being able to get up from my desk and walk around my Apartment when I need to while I am listening to something is what I was aiming for.The quality again for me is really good, I am not a sound engineer so I could not tell you where on the spectrum of sound they fit but for the price to me they do the job I expect of them. All around a good pair of headphones for the price.Battery life may not be up to 50 hours because the battery monitor remained at 100% even though I had them on almost all day. But, they certainly lasted well past the 2 - 5 hours of wearing them compared to a pair of Apple AirPod Pros. I still want to kick myself for buying the Apple ones not realizing for the price they didn't last very long on a single charge.I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.comment: My wife and I both got matching pairs (mine is tan hers is pink), and so far we are loving it. Great sound quality and I can talk on the phone with them as well (which I’m not used to). It’s also her first personal pair of headphones she’s ever had which she was (and still is) excited for. The battery life is great and it’s compact for easy storage. My only reason for not giving them 5 is that the headphones aren’t too comfortable in that they make your ears sore after long periods of having them on (due to not going over your ears but instead on them). Also because of the compact build it’s a bit difficult to rest them around your neck (but very comfortable to just have them on the head behind the ears). I’d say it’s still well worth the price and a great buy despite that (also love the colors).

reviews.author: Ribbon HU
reviews.comment: Fantastic entry-level wireless headphones! They connect instantly, and the sound quality is clear with no static. The biggest selling point is definitely the 50-hour battery life, which is more than enough for daily use. They are lightweight to wear, and the black color goes with everything. The delivery was right on time, too. Very satisfied with this purchase, definitely worth it!

name: Ljusmicker for AirPods Pro 3 Case 2025 with Cleaner Kit,Black
shortDescription: Ljusmicker for AirPods Pro 3 Case 2025 with Cleaner Kit,Black
fullDescription: Ljusmicker for AirPods Pro 3 Case 2025 with Cleaner Kit,Black

reviews.author: CARLOS
reviews.comment: I’m very happy with this AirPods 4 case! It fits my 2024 AirPods perfectly and provides great protection against scratches and everyday wear. The material feels durable, and the case is lightweight without adding extra bulk. I also love the stylish design and how easy it is to access the charging port. It’s a great combination of quality, protection, and value. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Brenda Cortez
reviews.comment: I really liked this case. It feels sturdy, has a nice design, and protects the AirPods very well. Plus, it fits snugly and is easy to put on. The material feels high-quality, and the carabiner is very handy for carrying them without worrying about them falling out or getting lost.Overall, I am very satisfied with the purchase. I recommend it to anyone looking for a stylish, practical, and protective case for their AirPods 4. 👍

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.comment: I love the color I got (wine red), but I also liked how many other color options they had. I had to get one of these since I kept dropping my unprotected case anytime I got out of the car (onto the driveway so it's all scratched now). I use the carabiner on the loop of my water bottle so both always make it to the gym with me! This was super easy to put on and perfectly seals around the case. Due to the carabiner I haven't dropped this yet, but if I did I know the case would be protected. Feels strong and durable, and I imagine I won't ever need to buy another one to replace this - at least until my AirPods die. The cleaning wand is also a nice addition, the fluffy end cleans out the holes in the case, and the other end gets the gunk out of the holes on the AirPods themselves. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Yanet
reviews.comment: I’m very happy with this headphone cover. It fits perfectly, looks stylish, and helps protect my headphones from scratches, dust, and everyday wear. The material feels durable and comfortable, and it was easy to put on. It adds a nice personal touch while keeping my headphones looking new. Great quality for the price, and I would definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Jonathan E.
reviews.comment: Overall I’m a little dissatisfied with this cover. Wanted something cheap but effective to cover my AirPods case.As you can see from the picture it does not fit snugly on the case. Parts of the case still show after putting it on and it looks uneven. The case also seems too thick and makes it a little more difficult to put the AirPods back inside when needed.Still able to charge via MagSafe without any issues. The brushes are also very helpful and make it easy to keep clean. The keychain inclusion is also a good touch and helpful when I’m traveling.If the fit was better I would have given this 5 stars.

name: Anker Power Strip with 2100J Surge Protector, Outlet Extender, 20W, 12 AC
shortDescription: Anker Power Strip with 2100J Surge Protector, Outlet Extender, 20W, 12 AC
fullDescription: Anker Power Strip with 2100J Surge Protector, Outlet Extender, 20W, 12 AC

reviews.author: Kevin Yang
reviews.comment: I am extremely happy with this Anker power strip. With 12 AC outlets, it easily accommodates all of my home office equipment without any crowding, thanks to the smart layout. The addition of the USB-C port (with 20W fast charging) and USB-A ports is incredibly convenient for powering up my phone and accessories directly without needing extra bricks. It feels sturdy, well-built, and gives me peace of mind with its 2100J surge protection. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: 2Stroke GoBrrrr
reviews.comment: Helped me clean up my rats nest of wires while giving me 3 extra charging ports. All ports put off power as rated. Holes for wall mounting could be bigger, or you can use double sided gorilla tape and just forget it (until you want to remove it, better have paint on hand). The plug spacing even lets me plug a ds charger next to my phone charger and they don't crash together. As with all of Anker's other products, it's overbuilt, and underpriced for what you're getting. Thing feels like a brick in your hand, which I like in a power strip, no give plugging things in, holds but doesn't make it impossible to remove. Just what you need to clean up your pc desk.

reviews.author: Mister Mike
reviews.comment: Perfect in all ways. Even down to the 2 mounting screws. I think it is fairly priced. Fits most normal size plugs for adapters. I’m using 6 adapters and several normal plugs and plenty of room. Didn’t use the USB yet, but will soon.

reviews.author: Key Wizard 75
reviews.comment: I have a fairly well equipped music studio and need lots of electrical outlets. This fits the bill in a compact and well designed receptacle, with very neatly optimized placement of 12 outlets with surge protection. The addition of 2 USB-A and USB-C plubs also very much comes in handy, especially for USB powered devices. It is working quite well.

reviews.author: RJ Skalet
reviews.comment: This power strip has plenty of outlets and USB ports for all of my devices. It feels well made, the spacing between outlets is great, and the built-in surge protection provides extra peace of mind.

name: (2 Pack) Replacement Remote Control for Roku TV, for TCL Roku/Onn Roku TVs
shortDescription: (2 Pack) Replacement Remote Control for Roku TV, for TCL Roku/Onn Roku TVs
fullDescription: (2 Pack) Replacement Remote Control for Roku TV, for TCL Roku/Onn Roku TVs

reviews.author: Bader Ale
reviews.comment: Item was received very quickly. I purchased the remote for an LG OLED smart tv I have (from around 2023). The remote came packaged in a simple wrapping - it included an small instruction manual. It did not include batteries (not a big deal)Once the batteries were connected, it worked within seconds. The TV recognized the remote, which has the "Magic Remote" feature (the dynamic pointer and not just the up/down arrows).All in all, very good purchase. Price was on point with purpose, quality and speed of delivery.

reviews.author: John E.
reviews.comment: Great deal for 2 replacement Roku remotes. Synced perfectly with my TCL Roku TV on the first try. The OEM remote buttons became worn out and unresponsive at times. These replacements were easy to set up and get going.

reviews.author: Kelly T
reviews.comment: So far so good with these remotes. Have had them for a couple of months and they work great. The kids lost our other remote so these were a good replacement that were a great value. We have a TCL Roku tv and these work great with it.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.comment: I honestly looked online for about 30 minutes and was using ChatGPT to help me find a replacement remote that would work with my Samsung TV purchased in 2020. I opted for this one, even though it was just a tad different than the remote that is currently lost somewhere in my house (my current remote is also slim, but the back is slightly angled or curved). The replacement remote was delivered today. I popped two new batteries in it… pointed it at the tv sensor and the tv turned on!!! Woot woot! I followed the directions to pair it and 30 seconds later, I can now use my TV again 🤗. I would recommend!

reviews.author: Takashia
reviews.comment: Took a little bit for me to get it connected to my TV, once it was connected no issues. Highly recommended. Also if you have a Samsung Series 5 TV (Like myself) the Netflix button does not work. Just a heads up for anyone looking to buy. That’s really the only flaw for me. It’s a 10/10 and highly recommended!

name: Roku 40-Inch Select Series Smart TV 2026-1080p Full HD TV - RokuTV
shortDescription: Roku 40-Inch Select Series Smart TV 2026-1080p Full HD TV - RokuTV
fullDescription: Roku 40-Inch Select Series Smart TV 2026-1080p Full HD TV - RokuTV

reviews.author: Mama GG
reviews.comment: Easy setup, great picture and sound and outstanding price

reviews.author: Mike Quarles
reviews.comment: I purchased this Roku 32 inch Smart TV to replace our RV stock TV. Huge difference. The mounting was easy and the slightly larger TV fills the area much better. The internal speaker is so much better than what we had previously. Also, the Smart TV function is very helpful, rather than dealing with an external Roku Stick. The price was reasonable and the quality is good enough for any RV install, even one that goes off-road. I would recommend this purchase to others. Great product!

reviews.author: Skydiver
reviews.comment: So far this has been a good tv. Good picture and sound. I was not happy with the roku auto picture as it was too dark. I went into picture settings and was able to adjust it to suit me. At first, the antenna channels kept dropping from the live tv guide but I was able to use voice remote to bring up the local channel I wanted and it came up no problem. Now, the local channels have remained in the guide... don't know what changed except that the home screen changed at same time so maybe an update corrected the problem. I don't care for the new homescreen but I am adjusting to it. I already had a Roku account so set up was not too difficult. Good thing too because instructions are absent. I am not very technically bright so making needed adjustments was challenging for me. I got good info about specific details by doing google searches on my phone. It would be nice if Roku gave us important information like the proper way to exit an app etc. I was doing the back button repeatedly until the exit app spot came up so I could exit. According to google search, Roku recommends we simply hit the home button to exit any app. Also, it is important to always go to home before turning tv off. Failing to do this could cause an app to continue steaming in the back ground. No instructions with this tv provided this info. I believe all tv sets should come with instruction manuals but sadly most tv sets and even other electronics no longer come with manuals. Maybe that's ok for the newer generations but it's annoying for us seniors.

reviews.author: Cody Rose
reviews.comment: Good picture, very easy to set up. Great TV for the price! Kids love it!!! Paired perfectly with cheap TV mount.

reviews.author: a customer
reviews.comment: Our fingers are crossed for this new Roku tv, considering the publicity about class action lawsuits re: Roku updates 'bricking' tv's. So far, a bit sub-par when compared to the Roku tv it replaces, but easily set up. If you've set up one Roku, you know it is very simple. Just have your phone and passwords available.But if you expect to find the plethora of audio settings, 'leveling, night, speech, music' , they are not there. You basically have volume. 'Sleep' must be set independently per app. And I will note that the 'Recommended' row above your Home Screen apps is there to stay. The only choice you get is one of privacy, ie 'Don't share my information.I have seen reviews about the sound. It seems sufficient, but does sometimes seem louder or softer than set. No big deal as the remote works well. I prefer to use the remote simply as a remote, no voice control, no linking to Alexa. Privacy matters these days.The picture is fine on Normal. My first move was to remove it from the Vivid or Brightest (showroom setting).If all goes well, this is an adequate tv. It deserves 4 *, no more. The updates are automatic, cannot be paused as I saw suggested on a tech site. We hope for the best but actually hung onto our previous 5 yr old, sometimes glitch- prone tv that we replaced. Our Family room Roku TV is still fairly new and has been trouble-free. This does receive local tv channels with the use of an antenna. Live Pause may/may not hold. Of course you need a USB stick for Live Pause. (90 minutes pause of Antenna tv)It was on sale for a decent price, hoping it proves to be a good value. Twice, we have had to unplug it for a few minutes to clear the cache.

name: FUJIFILM Instax Mini Instant Film Twin Pack (White), 20 Photos
shortDescription: FUJIFILM Instax Mini Instant Film Twin Pack (White), 20 Photos
fullDescription: FUJIFILM Instax Mini Instant Film Twin Pack (White), 20 Photos

reviews.author: Paul weekley
reviews.comment: The film works great and is very easy to load into the camera. The pictures develop nicely with good color and that classic Instax look. The twin pack is convenient and gives you plenty of pictures for parties, trips, and special memories.

reviews.author: motingyu
reviews.comment: Works perfectly with my Instax Mini camera.The photos came out clear with nice colors,and the film was easy to loda.Everything arrived in good condition and worked exactly as expected.Very happy with the purchase and would buy again.

reviews.author: Valerie Durham
reviews.comment: This Fujifilm Instax Mini film is absolutely fantastic! The photos come out bright, clear and with great color reproduction. The twin pack gives you 20 photos which is perfect for events and gatherings. The photos develop quickly and make such a fun keepsake. We used them at a birthday party and everyone loved them. The quality is consistent across all the shots. Will definitely continue buying this film!

reviews.author: Olivia Wiest
reviews.comment: ALWAYS A HIT when I bring my camera and use this film!The photos develop clearly with bright colors and that classic instant film look that makes pictures feel extra special. Super easy to load into the camera and perfect for parties, travel, scrapbooks, or capturing fun everyday moments.Always reliable and worth keeping on hand for Instax cameras.When I travel I always hand check this film when going through security JUST IN CASE!The quantity (20) is perfect. I never use as much film as I think I am going to.

reviews.author: YOS VALDERRAMA
reviews.comment: Everything about this product is great. It arrived on time, was exactly as described, and works flawlessly. I couldn't be happier with my purchase.

name: Apple 2026 MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop with A18 Pro chip: Built for AI and Apple Intelligence, Liquid Retina Display, 8GB Unified Memory, 256GB SSD Storage, 1080p FaceTime HD Camera; Indigo
shortDescription: Apple 2026 MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop with A18 Pro chip: Built for AI and Apple Intelligence, Liquid Retina Display, 8GB Unified Memory, 256GB SSD Storage...
fullDescription: Apple 2026 MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop with A18 Pro chip: Built for AI and Apple Intelligence, Liquid Retina Display, 8GB Unified Memory, 256GB SSD Storage, 1080p FaceTime HD Camera; Indigo

reviews.author: John L. Bartley
reviews.comment: The MacBook Neo 13-inch is an impressive laptop that offers excellent performance, portability, and value. The A18 Pro chip handles everyday tasks effortlessly, from web browsing and streaming to productivity work and AI-powered features. Everything feels smooth, fast, and responsive.The Liquid Retina display is bright and sharp, delivering beautiful colors and great clarity for both work and entertainment. Despite its compact size, the laptop provides a comfortable viewing experience and is easy to carry anywhere.The 256GB SSD offers quick startup times and fast access to files, while the 1080p FaceTime HD camera delivers clear video quality for meetings and calls. The Citrus color adds a unique and refreshing look that stands out from traditional laptop designs.Battery life is excellent, and the overall build quality feels premium and durable. reviews.author: Eric the K
reviews.comment: If I were picking nits, I'd trim a half star for some of the cost-saving choices Apple made with the Neo --- worst among them being the lack of a backlit keyboard (or at least printing the keyboard characters in a highly contrasting color --- like white-on-gray and not dark gray on lighter gray). Also, having only two USB-C ports in close proximity (rather than on opposite sides) seems a poor design choice and having one of those ports be USB 2 in this day and age seems unnecessarily cheap. However, as I said, these are minor annoyances and don't detract all that much from the elegance of the machine.What you are getting is the cheapest Mac money has ever been able to buy (cheaper even than most 2020 Macbook Air models on the used market. You're also getting a laptop that's highly portable, powerful, with great battery life, impressive graphics, Apple Intelligence and that can run iOS and iPadOS apps in addition to those for MacOS.I got the Neo as a (relatively) cheap, take-anywhere traveling companion for a trip to the Amazon and Galapagos Islands. I needed to be able to run my usual software and didn't want to expose my primary laptop to the risks of theft, canoe travel, jungle heat and humidity or wet landings. I took precautions, yes, but the Neo performed perfectly (as I would expect).For all its capabilities and price, I have no qualms about giving the Neo five stars...but Apple better do something about that keyboard in the next iteration.

reviews.author: Keith Pearce
reviews.comment: The neo is really impressive for $600. It has a nice screen, an incredibly rigid aluminum chassis, loads web pages and videos super fast, boots quick. Impressive Bluetooth and WiFi range and performance (Bluetooth is so much better then my old laptop), good speakers(for a laptop), good battery life, a decent keyboard, excellent trackpad, decent web cam, looks nice, low heat output and no vents to get blocked, compact and light. Highly recommended for anyone shopping for a compact web machine.The only negatives on the hardware are: lack of keyboard backlight, the interior edge of the chassis is sharp, not enough to cut you, but enough to be annoying when typing in some positions, not many ports just a normal USB C and a 2.0 speed USB C (both can be used for charging) and screen does not fold flat, so the laptop cannot be stood up against the wall.I was a bit unsure about the Neo because of it using a cellphone chip, but that was not a problem at all. The Neo is super snappy, as fast as my Workstation/Gaming PC when loading web pages and videos. Also I have not noticed any issues with the amount of RAM, 8GB seems sufficient for running a web browser, just as long as you do not go crazy on tabs in Chrome or if you use Firefox that actually manages tabs properly. As a web browser machine I doubt that this will have any performance issues. I am sure that you would hit limits of the mobile CPU if you do did something serious like video editing, but it is more then enough for more casual use.As someone who had never used a mac before I was a bit apprehensive about trying a different OS, but really it has been fine. I mostly just use my laptop to run a web browser, so I do not interact with the OS that much and MacOS is really pretty nice in many ways. The hardest thing to get used to will be the copy paste shortcuts using command instead of ctrl. Mostly MacOS functions about the same as windows, just better. You can just shut the lid on the Neo and it actually shuts off without hardly using any battery and instantly resumes when you open it again. When you do shut it down boot time is super fast. Mac's update system is pretty unobtrusive and just not stupid like windows update. Mac wants you to sign up to all of their AI and cloud stuff, but you do not have to. I did not even setup the app store. The only apps that I wanted were Firefox and a system wide EQ for my earbuds. I found eqMac on gethub, the free version works pretty well. Anyway don't let the different OS scare you away, MacOS is pretty decent and not really that much different then windows. I got used to it in 2 days of use. Also it should get 7 years of software support.Here is a comparison of the Neo with the 4 year old Lenovo Yoga 13 it is replacing. The Lenovo was $550 when new so a very similar price category from 4 years ago. Not sure if this will be useful to anyone so I am putting this at the end, but I figure that a lot of people will be in the same situation switching from a budget windows machine from a few years ago, Overall the Neo is better in almost every way, except for the screen not being able to fold around like the yoga and the lack of a backlit keyboard.The Neo is much faster, it way outperforms the AMD 4650u in my old lenovo when it comes to loading web pages and videos. My old laptop had started really chugging lately when loading YouTube and twitch videos. Not sure it there is something wrong my old laptop it or if web sites have just gotten that much harder to run.My old lenovo Yoga 13 has an absurd amount of flex in the plastic chassis, when you pick up one corner of the device the other edge sags visibly, the keyboard flexes noticeably when typing, the entire chassis will twist with very little effort. The chassis has also cracked in several places and I have been having to superglue it back together to keep the chassis from literally falling apart. The Neo on the other hand is completely rigid you can lift it anywhere, no flex in the keyboard, you would have to really try to do anything to this thing, it is amazing for a laptop of any price, much less a $600 one. Unless you really do something terrible to it I expect the Neo chassis to last well beond the lifetime of the hardware.The battery life on the neo is great, I would say it is about twice that of the lenovo, even though I just put a new battery in my lenovo 6 months ago.The Bluetooth range on the Neo is at least 2 times better, my earbuds would loose connection to the lenovo if I walked 20 feet away to go to the bathroom. I can walk anywhere in the house and stay connected to the Neo, range of about 40+ feet in the house and about 80+ feet outside. Not only the range is better but also Bluetooth connects faster and just works kind of flawlessly, while in windows I constantly had odd Bluetooth issues. This is with just some basic $30 Anker Bluetooth earbuds.WiFI range and throughput is also much better then my old laptopThe yogo 13 had a good screen, so I do not find the screen of the Neo a huge upgrade, it is noticeably more vibrant and it is higher res, although I found 1980x1080 to be fine at this size. Also the Yoga 13 screen could fold all of the way back and around into any position you want and it was touchscreen, so some improvements and some downsides. Still the color on the Neo screen is very nice.The speakers in the Neo are many times better then the the Lenovo, my old Pixel phone even easily outdid the Lenovo, it had impressively bad speakers.The webcam on the Neo is also a big upgrade over the Lenovo, higher res and just better all around.The Neo has a macbook keyboard, so generally it is a very good laptop keyboard. It is not my favorite type of keyboard, but it works quite well and is fast to type.The trackpad is great, it is so much better then any windows computer trackpad that I have used, it functions a bit different so it takes a bit of getting used to, but it is just so much better then windows trackpads.As the Neo uses a cellphone chip it does not really need any cooling, so there are no vents and the chassis never gets hot or even warm. My old lenovo would get uncomfortably hot when charging and I had to be careful not to block the vents when using it on a bed or blanket, but that is not a problem with the Neo. There are no vents to block.Overall this thing is just impressive for $600 and I just do not see any windows laptop coming close to competing for a thin and light web machine. Sure if you want something that can game or do more intensive work stuff, but I just wanted something to run a web browser and this does that incredibly well while also being a beautifully well made device.

reviews.comment: Yes, my subject line sounds like that trash hyperbole you get on annoying pop-up ads on your Smartphone! And ironically, it usually has to do with ear buds. There are tons of them on the market, and everyone claims to be the best.Now, first off, I am just a customer… never got any gifts or money or anything from this company, nor was asked to “click on a review” for a discount or whatever. No… the reason for all this hallelujah chorus, is that I’m really totally both jazzed, and a bit in awe of these earbuds. I think the main mind-blowing thing about them is the price. I mean, I have a bit of experience and knowledge with this kind of technology, and frankly, these days, what “guts” that are needed to be used to create Bluetooth ear buds is not that complex… nor expensive. How company’s like Sony, Apple, Bose, etc. can charge upwards of $300 for these boarders on theft and fraud!I’ve tried those “Rolls Royce” buds, and I urge you to do the same, and then try these Tagry Bluetooth Wireless Earbuds that are literally 90% less expensive. They come with a pleasant woman’s voice letting you know various messages, like which earbud is in what ear, if they are connected or turned off, your volume control (including excess volume warning), etc.I’ve had these for several months, and have found the charging, which has a bright LED display and shows the individual charging of each bud, along with their percentage easy to read.And a note on their service. I’ve heard horror stories of folks trying to reach the outrageously over-priced other earbud company’s for tech support, or refunds, exchanges, etc. Basically it’s nonexistent, and when you do miraculously find a phone number to call them, and get someone on the line, you have to go to the UN to find an interpreter of rare third-world languages to understand what they are saying, and they seem to be trained, not on anything to do with the product, but to make the call as useless and confusing as possible, so that you will just give up and throw their buds, and your money in the trash.Now, I did have an initial problem, after a few months, in that the base charger seemed to be slowing a bit. Tagry gives you a LIFETIME WARRANTY… yes, an actually lifetime warranty, not one of those sham “lifetime warranties”, that corrupt company’s like Hammacher Schlemmer have.I had enrolled with Tagry, on their website, to activate my warranty as soon as I received the buds. I called Tagry when I was seeing what could be a glitch in their charging base, and yes, unlike most other companies who hide their contact numbers as if they were nuclear codes, Tagry’s support phone number is plainly printed on their manual, and to my astonishment, I immediately was connected to a good ‘ol American customer service person, who actually worked for the company, spoke English, and made me feel as if I was a long-ago trusted friend. They truly cared, and said they were sorry, and that there was no need to troubleshoot the base, or return it, instead, they would process an order to send me a new one.A day later, they actually called me back to let me know that the replacement had been shipped, and that I should have it in a day or so, and if not, to please call them back right away. And yes, to apologize again for any inconvenience. The replacement arrived the very next day. And again, their warranty is indeed for a lifetime, a no questions asked replacement policy. This is how much they believe in their product, and respect their customers.So, yes. It is insane to pay more than $35 for quality Bluetooth earbuds. Last year, I sent about a dozen of these out to friends and employees, to use for personal use, and for all that Zooming going on… and they love them. And none of had any problems.I’m sure you have had a plethora of bad experiences in the past few years, what with isolation, and way too much ordering on-line, finding the products you buy to be substandard, and customer service virtually non-existent. And that is why I’ve spend all this time expounding on the greatest of my earbuds. Yes, I have a life. Really. But what a joy to be able to tell a story like this, rather than the kind of frustration most of us are experiencing every day!Yes, goodness and quality still exist. It’s rare… but it’s out there!

reviews.comment: I’m really happy with the JBL Vibe Beam True Wireless Earbuds in Blue. The sound is clear and crisp, and the bass is surprisingly powerful for such compact earbuds. reviews.author: P. Dobrinen
reviews.comment: This review is about the audio features of the JBL Vibe Beam earbuds.I'm an audio engineer so audio quality is very important to me. As such, I use wired connections as much as possible to maintain the integrity of the audio signal. However, many newer consumer-level products no longer have audio jacks, so I finally decided to invest in some wireless earbuds as a backup to the other earphones and headphones that I use. I didn't want to spend a lot of money as I didn't foresee myself using this product very much, and since this is my first foray into wireless audio earphones, if they were just ok or they broke after a while, then I wouldn't feel too bad about the little money that I spent. Also, I wanted to focus on finding wireless earbuds with excellent audio quality first as I already have an excellent high-end bluetooth earpiece for cell phone use, and I wouldn't be using this product as a bluetooth headset for my phone.After doing much research, I chose the JBL Vibe Beam's as they were at my price point, I'm familiar with JBL products, and I could reasonably expect that they were likely deliver the high audio quality that I've come to expect from JBL products. In my research, I read reviews that complained about the harshness of the high end with high frequency instruments like cymbals or the lack of bass, so I was a bit concerned.When I received and started listening to my JBL Vibe Beams I understood what people were talking about. However, to correct the issues, first, one must have a great fit of the earbuds in their ears. I'm fortunate, in that with the medium tips that were already installed on the Vibe Beams, they made a snug fit in my ears right out of the box. If you find that these earbuds do not fit well in your ears it might be worthwhile to invest in a separate set of variable sized earbud tips, or try tips from one of your other well-fitting earbuds, if you have them. Once the earbuds were seated properly in my ear, that took care of the poor bass issue. (I have not worn them long-term so I can't speak to them falling out of my ear, as others have mentioned, but they seem to stay in pretty well.)For the misaligned frequency response issue, fortunately, the JBL Headphone app that you can install on your cell phone includes a ten-band graphic equalizer that you can use to make adjustments to the frequency response of your earbuds. After listening to several of the reference tracks I use to check new audio equipment or my mixes against, I found that the only adjustments needed were carving out some of the upper midrange and making a very slight boost in the bottom end of the lower frequency spectrum. I've included a screenshot of my EQ curve which I based on the Bass preset in the JBL app. You can't tell as there is no dB scale on the side, but I needed to cut or boost by only 1-2 dB. I find that my new EQ curve gives a more balanced frequency response than what came out of the box, and matches up well against the reference speaker system and headphones that I use for my audio mixing and mastering work. I invite you to use my EQ curve as a starting point and adjust as sounds best to you.I also read reviews complaining about the apparent lack of volume of the Vibe Beams. I connected the JBL's to several different sources (phone, computer, TV, MP3 player, etc.) and I found that the overall maximum volume (with limiter off) is relatively lower than wired speaker versions. However, the input to the JBL's is relative to the maximum output of the source itself. I found that the loudest level I could get came from my iPhone and the lowest level output came from my MP3 player (which probably doesn't offer much output anyway being a tiny portable unit). As a comparison, I did a side-by-side test of the JBL's with my wife's AirPods (2nd gen). What I found was that the JBL's offered an almost identical audio output level as the AirPods with any of the sources I used so that confirmed that the output level of the JBL's has more to do with the source (and the source material as some songs are mastered at a lower volume than other songs) than with the earbuds themselves. During my test, I put the JBL's at their maximum volume output (one tap at a time on the left bud to raise the volume). Also, I noticed during my testing that the AirPods had a pleasing midrange sound perfect for listening to podcasts or watching video, but the JBL's excelled at full-range sound on the bottom and top ends of the frequency spectrum which made them sound much better over all and well-suited for music or listening to explosive action scenes in movies.And speaking of movies, the JBL app has a switchable audio/video mode. The video mode reduces the latency of the delivery of audio against picture, so there isn't a noticeable lip-sync issue with dialogue in a scene. However, there is a slight degradation in the audio quality of 'video' mode versus 'audio' mode, but you will have to make the determination if the change in audio quality is acceptable to you.As a side note, I included a picture of the inner side of the earbuds. The 'L' and 'R' designations on the earbuds are tiny as you can see, plus they are the same color as the earbuds themselves, so they are very hard to see. I wish JBL had made the L/R letters bigger or at least made them a different color so they would be easier to see.The pairing process was fairly easy with all my bluetooth-capable devices and the range was good, only dropping out after walking approximately 60-70 feet from the source. There was one momentary dropout during my listening but that could be due to my wife using her AirPods the same time as I was using the JBL's.I can't speak to the other features of the JBL Vibe Beams as I don't intend to use them, but as far as audio quality goes, with just a few minor tweaks, these bluetooth earbuds can go from sounding like a $50 pair of earbuds to a $500 pair of reference earphones.

If I do, usually on busier/ longer days, I put them in the case for maybe 10 minutes and they're ready to go for the rest of the day!Even after all this time/use they still charge quickly and hold a charge very well.If I listen to music, the battery does drain faster, so on those days I do have to charge them extra, but they still only need a few minutes in the charging case. The case holds a charge exceptionally well. I only have to charge the case every other day.This pair of earbuds has held up to me dropping them more times than I can count. I am really hard on them and they are really standing the test of time!I have very small ears and even small earbuds hurt my ears or just won't stay in them, but not these. They stay in my ear well most days and are so comfortable I forget that I am wearing them. I live in the deep south with horrible heat and humidity, and on those days the earbuds can sometimes work their way out of my ear, but that would happen with any earbuds while sweating in a triple degree heat index! I mean, it is hot enough to make your ears sweat! Lol My son borrows them occasionally and the larger rubber earpieces fit perfectly for him. They're really easy to pop the rubber ear piece off and clean with alcohol wipes.While the sound quality isn't top of the line, it's pretty great for how little these cost!I am soft spoken and have had issues in the past with callers hearing me with other Bluetooth, but I haven't had that issue with these. I can hear callers well, as well as them hearing me well. I keep the earbuds set to "ambient aware" and can hear everything going on around me as well as whatever is playing through the earbuds.I don't like spending a lot of money on earbuds because I have broken/ lost so many!! (dropped in: bucket of mop water, airplane toilet, the gap walking into the elevator, trash chute, and a storm drain). So instead of getting a high end Bluetooth that cost more, I was trying to find the best earbuds I could for as low a price as I could find.I tried these since the price was so low. I figured if I have to replace them at least I'm not paying too much, but instead, I found a pair of earbuds I love! And I love the pretty ballerina pink!

reviews.author: a viewer
reviews.comment: These earbuds work great with my iPhones 13 and 17. They paired easily (remove them from the case) and the sound is good to my non-technical ears. Using the free JBL phone app, the functions of each bud can be changed to your preference, and they also connect with Siri and take phone calls although I've not used those two features yet. I have the left one controlling volume and the right one controlling play/pause and forward/back. You can choose the noise cancelling controls instead of one of those if you want. You can also change the sound and other things in the phone app. The app adds a lot of options. The buds are comfortable in my ears.They work less well with my Fire tablet, although they do work. It took several tries to get them to pair and the sound doesn't seem quite as good, but this Fire tablet is quirkier than a previous Fire I had. Also, the magnets in the case seem strong and the buds are sometimes a little difficult to grasp and remove from the case, but that's a minor thing. I've only had them a couple of days with no problems so far. I walked down my driveway to my mailbox at the road with them paired to my iPhone in the house and they did not drop the sound, so the range seems good.These replace a pair of more expensive Beats Studio buds that apparently sat in a drawer too long. I can't get those to charge now and I need a pair for an upcoming trip. AI says the battery in those is probably gone. The cases are a similar size and appearance. No complaints with these JBL buds so far and they seem to be a better value.

reviews.author: Al Alzubaidy
reviews.comment: These are really solid ear buds. They have ambient noise and noise canceling. The noise canceling isn’t the greatest but it’s pretty solid for the price they come with different rubber tips so if you change to a size better suited for your ears you may get a better experience with the noise canceling. They stay in my ears too, something I can’t say for many other ear buds. I fell asleep with them in and they were still on the next day when I woke up. One thing I’m not fond of is pairing them they’re not as straight forward like air pods. You also can’t see the battery life unless you download the JBL app for them. The coolest feature for me that I found is in the app if you drop an ear buds or lose one as long as it is paired to your phone and has battery life there’s a ping feature that puts out a very loud sound and I’ve actually used this outside when I dropped one of them in the grass. The battery life is really good I get a whole day usually off the charge plus the case keeps them charged too. I use these for phone calls as well people always tell me I sound clear so they have good microphones. Honestly for the price point I recommend these to anyone.

reviews.author: Anna Flores
reviews.comment: Just got these, and for the price they’re not bad. The noise canceling option is decent, but not amazing. I like that I can adjust sounds through the app and they feel comfortable on my ears and not feeling like they’ll fall. There were some connectivity issues, but only as I was getting them set up and the sound quality is decent as well, though some things sounded louder than others. They battery life seems very good, I charged once and used all day (pausing many times) and the battery only went about 5%. Giving 4 stars only because the sound could be crisper and smoother, but for the price, they get the job done.

reviews.author: Jason Moonsmith
reviews.comment: Not impressed. I purchased this set https://a.co/d/09jpLM2h and have used them daily for over a year. I like them so much I bought the black and white versions. I decided to get an ,"upgrade" for my birthday and purchased this JBL set, as I'm kind of a JBL fanboy. While the sound is marginally better, everything else about them is not.The $20 no name set is more intuitive, has more control options, and a better case. Cheap buds lower volume and rewind/previous song from the left bud, volume up and fast forward on the right bud. JBLa have NO VOLUME control, and all seek pause functions are controlled by just the right bud. The left bud operates the AI and non-existent noise cancelling. They don't even feel as nice as the cheaper set. Not having volume control is very frustrating. The cheaper buds have a better feel to them, like an actual touch screen. The JBLs feel like a pen. Not as pleasant.The case is worse too. The cheap one has a digital display that shows how much charge the case has. The JBL just has a single led that shows green, yellow or red. What do those colors mean? No idea. They even store oddly. The $20 ones ear easier to remove from the case too.And lastly the $20 set lasts between 30 minutes to an hour longer than the JBLs.Other than the tiny difference in audio quality, the ones that cost half as much are many times better in functionality. I am truly disappointed.**Edited July 13th, 2026. I had the left earbud in while taking a shower. It got wet, and now the volume doesn't work. Returned as defective.**

reviews.author: FoodNut
reviews.comment: Great sound and super easy to connect to an iphone. Battery life is very good, used it for 5+ hours twice and it recharged very quickly in under an hour. Haven't dropped it in the pool yet but with an IXP7 rating and Anker as the maker I'm sure they'll be no problems if I did. It is a solid & heavy not a flimsy plastic unit that can't take heavy use. I coupled it with an Anker 25w C type USB charger that works perfectly with it. Very happy with the purchase.

reviews.author: JOU EN WEI
reviews.comment: The sound quality is excellent, it’s compact and easy to carry around, the volume is loud enough, and the battery life is great. It’s truly perfect! Amazing item.

reviews.author: shueparm
reviews.comment: These Bluetooth speakers pair with my devices quickly and easily. They produce clear, high-quality sound with impressive bass for their size. The indicator lights are helpful and make the speaker easy to use. I also appreciate how versatile they are—they perform well whether I'm using them indoors at home or outdoors while traveling or relaxing outside. The sleek black finish gives the speaker a modern, stylish look. Overall, this is a durable, great-sounding portable speaker with excellent battery life, and I'm very happy with my purchase.

reviews.author: SassyRose
reviews.comment: Totally worth it! I forgot my JBL GO 4 when travelling. I was speaking at a workshop and they didn't have audio, only a projector and I wanted to show a video. I shipped this to me hotel and it paired up quickly.The sound is rich and round and deeper than my JBL Go 4. I used this to create classroom ambience with some lo fi beats and then queued up my video. It was more than enough to fill a room of 30-50 people.It also gets louder than the JBLs (JBLs are brighter).Especially as this price point it's a no brainer. Get it!Only downside, which may be an upside for others, is that it had an auto shut off after x amount of time. Great if you're trying to save battery. I booted it up and wanted it to stay on during my workshop as the video came in on my slides at about the 30 min mark and the speaker has turned off by then. No biggie. Just powered it back on and it paired immediately but wish I could turn that feature off

name: Surge Protector Power Strip - Nuetsa Flat Plug Extension Cord with 8 Outlets and 4 USB Ports, 6 Feet Power Cord, 2700 Joules, ETL Listed, Black
shortDescription: Surge Protector Power Strip - Nuetsa Flat Plug Extension Cord with 8 Outlets and 4 USB Ports, 6 Feet Power Cord, 2700 Joules, ETL Listed, Black
fullDescription: Surge Protector Power Strip - Nuetsa Flat Plug Extension Cord with 8 Outlets and 4 USB Ports, 6 Feet Power Cord, 2700 Joules, ETL Listed, Black

reviews.author: SHANYG
reviews.comment: I am extremely pleased with the Nuetsa Surge Protector Power Strip! This sleek power strip fits perfectly on my nightstand, which was exactly what I was looking for. The flat plug design is a game-changer - it allows the furniture to sit flush against the wall without any awkward gaps.The 8 outlets provide more than enough connections for all my bedside essentials: lamp, phone charger, tablet charger, and even my small fan. What really elevates this product are the 4 USB ports, eliminating the need for bulky charging blocks and keeping my nightstand looking clean and organized.The 6-foot extension cord gives me plenty of flexibility for placement, and I appreciate that it's not too long where I'd have excess cord to hide. The surge protection gives me peace of mind, especially when charging multiple devices overnight.The overall design is sleek and modern, not an eyesore like some power strips can be. It's low-profile enough to be practical without being obtrusive. If you're looking for a well-designed, functional power solution for your nightstand or other furniture, I highly recommend this Nuetsa surge protector!

reviews.author: David K. Clarke
reviews.comment: I am extremely happy with this Nuetsa power strip. It solved my cord management issues behind my furniture and gave me plenty of extra outlets for all my devices.Perfect Flat Plug: The ultra-slim flat plug fits beautifully behind my heavy furniture, allowing me to push it almost completely flush against the wall without bending or damaging the cord.Excellent Layout: Having 8 outlets is fantastic, but the real win is the layout. The wide spacing between the outlets easily accommodates larger brick adapters without blocking neighboring slots.Bonus USB Ports: The 4 built-in USB ports are incredibly convenient. It saves me from needing to find extra charging blocks for my phone, tablet, and other small electronics.Heavy-Duty Protection: With 2700 Joules of surge protection, I feel completely safe plugging my expensive electronics into it. It feels very solid and well-constructed.If you are looking to tidy up your entertainment center, home office, or bedroom setup, this power strip is an excellent choice. Definitely worth a five-star rating!

reviews.author: GiGi
reviews.comment: It’s still early, but so far, so good! We currently have five components connected, and everything is working exactly as expected.We purchased this surge protector for a new TV, but also needed to connect our internet modem, router, DVD player, and Roku. It has handled everything without any issues so far. We have only used the standard plug connections thus far.We’re giving it 5 stars based on our initial experience. If we encounter any short-term reliability issues, we’ll update the review accordingly.

reviews.author: Shwavy
reviews.comment: The pictures and description in the listing is accurate. I have been using this powerstrip for over 1 year now with no issues. The device itself has a sturdy, plastic housing with all ports perfectly lined up with the case openings, a 8 foot 9-10mm thick power cord with a thick strain relief where the cord exits the power strip, and an angled, against the wall plug for a tidy look.Usage of the power strip consists of a ON/RESET (OFF) switch, ground indicator led, and a protected led. Both led's should light up if everything is working well. The USB-C port and the USB-A ports are NOT quick charge ports; ouput is only 5V/3A. Though the power rating of the power strip is 1875W and you have a device with a power rating over 1000W, it is highly advised to plug that device directly into a wall outlet and not the power strip. The power strip can be optionally wall mounted via the screw head holes on the back of the device; mounting screws are not included.What i did not see in on the device or in the little manual is what you really need to know about a surge protector and that is the clamping voltage, response time, etc., however, under "Safety Notification #4" in the manual, it says "This product is only a outlet extender..." With that being said, i wouldn't use this with any high end equipment, tv's, home entertainment system, etc.As i initally stated, I have been using this over a year and it as been working flawlessly for me with what I'm using it for. The numerous outlets allow me to plug in the numerous AC adapters i have that seem to come with every device nowadays. I have my router, external USB drive, NAS drive, 2 network switches, and my ooma adapter all plugged in. Very happy with this purchase!

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.comment: So far so good! Got this when we set up my son’s new bed and entertainment center. He has so many consoles and lights! This has a good number of outlets and were far enough apart we could plug in different kinds of plugs. Also like how long the cord is. And the flat plug is a life-saver! It made it so easy to plug in behind the entertainment center.Now if only we were better at cable management. 😅

The 6 outlets provide plenty of space for my everyday devices, and the build quality feels solid for the price. I especially like the added peace of mind from the surge protection and circuit breaker, and the LED indicator makes it easy to know it’s working properly. It���s a great value product; affordable, dependable, and perfect for home or office use. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a basic, no-fuss power strip.

reviews.author: Jose
reviews.comment: My power strip before was already breaking and showing it's age, with it's white color becoming more of a yellowish color and it started to make a buzzing noise, thankfully, Amazon is there to have a great replacement for my old power strip. name: Amazon Basics Full Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount, with Swivel and Tilt, for 26" to 55" TVs and Flat Panels up to 80 Lbs, VESA Compatible, Single Stud, Black

fullDescription: Amazon Basics Full Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount, with Swivel and Tilt, for 26" to 55" TVs and Flat Panels up to 80 Lbs, VESA Compatible, Single Stud, Black

reviews.author: Ledor
reviews.comment: Perfect for a 50” Hisense! Came packaged with everything except the drill bits and a stud finder. The small level they included was nice, but I had a larger magnetized one that made the job a lot easier. The guide was true to size and made mapping out the holes a breeze. I measured several times and found the perfect stud positioned smack dab in the center of the wall. Measured a reasonable height, then prepared for the drill. This was my first installing one of these, so I took my time, but it’s a piece of cake.I started small and gradually worked my way up to a 1/4” which worked seemed to better suited than the 5/16” bit the instructions suggested. Considering the size of the mounting screw sleeves I’d make sure to have the 1/4” handy. The 3 bolts went in with ease and the level got it perfectly straight.I used the four extensions for the bracket which made it possible to explore at least 3 different configurations for the height of the screen. I experimented with the middle setup first, tried the TV on the mount and decided the lowest mounting position was best given the way I prefer to view TV. Took out down reset it, then finished up sniffing it down. Used the level to ensure both the full extension and flush against the wall positions were dead in straight.The 15° tilt doesn’t seem like much looking at the mount itself, but it’s really dramatic once you mount the display, exactly what I was shooting for. Everything is snugged down tightly and I have full confidence this thing isn’t going anywhere. It’s strong, secure and swings around effortlessly. It is kind of tricky knowing which way the arm is folding without feeling strong back there, but for the freedom to articulate it to the right or left that’s something I’ll deal with. This thing is a great value! Wish I’d bought it sooner!

reviews.author: Amber Barckholtz
reviews.comment: I used this Amazon Basics TV wall mount in my office, and it worked out great. Assembly was easy, and the instructions were simple to follow. I also really liked that it came with several different hardware options for mounting it to the wall and attaching the TV, which made the whole process much easier. It feels sturdy and secure once installed. Great value and a solid option if you’re looking for an easy TV wall mount.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.comment: Very solid construction. Full arm movement for different angles. Good instructions and everything needed to install included. Very happy with purchase.

reviews.author: Marlene
reviews.comment: What I like about this wall mount is that I can swivel and tilt my tv as needed when I am watching something. It is very good quality, at first I was scared to tilt the tv for fear that it might fall off. But after tilting it time and time again I have nothing to worry about. It is a great wall mount for a low price. It was also easy to install with the directions provided. There are also many tutorial you can find online!

reviews.author: jjgeddis
reviews.comment: Would be 5 stars but the instructions were not clear on which side the TV backplate should face. I assumed that the side with Amazon Basics would face out but that was wrong. Otherwise, installation was simple. Product seems of good quality and holds my 48" TV securely with no wobble or sag. The articulate arms allow you to maneuver the TV in just about any direction even flush against the wall. I would purchase this product again if I needed to mount another TV.
